## Stage 1: Deterministic Review Writer

Manually-pasted fake research -> Ollama Writer -> validation -> Ollama QA -> Save. (Node labels still say "Ollama" - they now call the DeepSeek API, renaming risked breaking name-based node references so it was left as a known cosmetic inconsistency.)

- Edit the model/API base URL in the **Config** node.
- Edit fake product/facts/findings/sentiment in **Product + Evidence**.
- "Save Review" is a placeholder terminal node - wiring it to WordPress is Stage 4.
- Requires a DeepSeek API key (DEEP_SEEK_API_KEY env var passed to the n8n container). Model: deepseek-flash.

**Structure enforced (2026-09-19):** every review must open with a complete Specifications section covering every supplied fact (no cherry-picking), and must close with an owner_consensus that blends every supplied owner-sentiment item (positive, negative and mixed) into one paragraph. Enforced twice: deterministically in **Validate Review** (checks every fact id / sentiment id is cited) and again by the **Ollama QA** pass (specifications_complete / owner_consensus_complete booleans, checked in **IF QA Passed?**).
